findings.claim_text: ER status is recorded for most samples.

evidence.calculation: samples with ER status recorded among primary tumor samples: 1048 / 1101 = 95.2%. ER status read from breast_carcinoma_estrogen_receptor_status (recorded for 1048 of 1101 primary tumors; alternatives: ER_Status_nature2012 (782)). Claim read as: 'most' means more than 50 percent.

findings.limitation: Presence in a file means the sample appears there; it says nothing about data quality or completeness inside the file. A clinical field counts as recorded when it holds a value (not blank or 'not available'); the values themselves were not verified.
next_actions: Check data quality inside the file, not just presence, before relying on it.

robustness.alt_rule: count every sample type (tumor, normal, metastasis) instead of primary tumors only

findings.claim_text: The cohort is large enough for a subtype comparison.

evidence.calculation: PAM50 subtype among primary tumor samples: recorded for 844 of 1101. Groups (samples, OS deaths): luma 421 (55 deaths); lumb 192 (32 deaths); basal 141 (19 deaths); her2 67 (14 deaths); normal 23 (5 deaths). Smallest group: normal with 23 samples and 5 deaths. PAM50 subtype read from PAM50Call_RNAseq (recorded for 844 of 1101 primary tumors; alternatives: PAM50_mRNA_nature2012 (522), Integrated_Clusters_with_PAM50__nature2012 (348)).

findings.limitation: Presence in a file means the sample appears there; it says nothing about data quality or completeness inside the file. A clinical field counts as recorded when it holds a value (not blank or 'not available'); the values themselves were not verified.
findings.review_reason: The claim has no measurable threshold; a person must decide what counts as large enough. The smallest group has only 23 samples. 3 group(s) have fewer than 20 deaths, which is thin for survival comparisons.
next_actions: State the minimum group size (and deaths) the comparison needs, then re-run.
Merge or drop the smallest group (normal, 23 samples) if the comparison needs balanced groups.
Check why 257 of 1101 samples have no recorded PAM50 subtype.

findings.claim_text: Every tumor sample has a matching pathology slide.

evidence.calculation: samples with pathology slides among primary tumor samples: 1098 / 1101 = 99.7%. Claim read as: 'all/every' means 100 percent. 3 of 1101 samples fall short of 'all'.

findings.limitation: A slide counts only when its barcode matches the sample; diagnostic and frozen slides are not separated here.
findings.review_reason: The result sits 0.3 points below the bar of 100%.
next_actions: Restrict the question to the 1098 samples that match, or choose a layer or field with better coverage.
Restate the claim with the measured figure (1098 of 1101).
